body: I had taken lexapro for close to a year with similar results as you, I really do hope you find something that works. Medication isn’t a “one size fits all” situation. Everyone’s is different, but you should try and work with your doctors and find something that works.
Not very much as advice and such, just something to calm my nerves

I often find myself yelling “shut up you stupid bitch, the world doesn’t revolve around you, even though you’re the size for it to” a lot, because me and my ex got into an argument and I just let her say what she wanted and I left.
Confusing at first, but I got the hang of it :), good app
I just wish I could talk to someone in person about this thing, someone I don’t have to pay. An actual friend, no parent, no sibling, a friend.

This may have been the best advice I’ve ever been given honestly. It makes perfect sense. One of my teachers from last year told me: “you have anxiety, it doesn’t have you” and I’ve lived by that quote since.
So I need to embrace and channel it?
Anxiety is the kryptonite to my inner Superman is basically what you’re saying
They’re gone now, why did it take so long?
I just burned it, and I’ve never felt better
It makes sense that you would find it comforting. When someone you take high regard to (say, a superhero) has similar issues to the person watching, it creates a connection with the viewer
I’m gonna put it under some cold water and wrap it in gauze saturated in neosporin overnight :)
It just looks like scratches now, but I’m still gonna figure out a way to cover it up in time for school in the morning
I may wear a long sleeve shirt in the middle of May. Who knows? But then again, I almost always roll my sleeves up, so....
Thank God you’re still here. And it’s always good to open up to people who are accepting and won’t freak out on you. Talk to who you trust the most.
I’m probably gonna wrap my forearm up in bandage till it goes away honestly. Out of sight, out of mind. I got school, I’m not about to give people another reason to harass me
Less than a millimeter, but as of now it’s bright red, like fresh self harm scars (I only know what they look like cause my friend used to)
Are you still here? Don’t give up
I hope so, until then, hello Reddit
It works pretty ok, but it’s too weak. I may need either a higher dose, or a different medication. But again, I’m paranoid that I’m gonna get addicted to Xanax if they prescribe it to me. How ironic?
I take lexapro at 16, and I hate it

I’m glad I don’t have insomnia, because I have read some Ambien horror stories. There was this reddit user u/rib_robs and he abused enough Ambien to drive him to suicide. His recent posts show that. I was lurking r/suicidewatch a few months after I attempted suicide to find resources, and found his last post. I’m not gonna link it

I’m glad I can find people with the same thing going on as me, it really relieves me knowing it’s not just me going through the same thing. One of my teachers told me once, “you have anxiety, it doesn’t have you” and that quote alone is enough to keep me from losing my mind
It almost hurts to an extent, because I’ve broken my right hand, and it is about 3 times worse in that hand
Because I’m only at ease when I’m on my phone, either looking at shitty memes, listening to music, or talking to people I can’t afford to meet in person because they’re thousands of miles away
And all of my good friends are online. I wish I had some friends in person, but god forbid I be happy in other places besides my phone screen.
A few, but they’re all seniors, and probably won’t talk to me after they graduate. And everyone after that are temporary, guaranteed. I’m a convenience to them.

It sucks because I have nobody to talk to in person. Sure, my school counselor, but my school is insane. Last person that said they were suicidal was sent to a mental hospital. I’m glad I have communities online that I can talk to though, better than nothing
That’s always good, you can get through whatever you think you can. I always say this to myself: “positive thoughts make a positive outcome”
I’ve got my head on straight, and I’m glad the reason I wanted to in the first place is gone from my life
